note: This file is a POINTER, not the fixture manifest. The fixture is generated,
never committed: `make fixtures` writes out/fixture.img and
out/fixture.manifest.json, and out/ is gitignored. The manifest that carries
the 40 planted files, their offsets, extents and SHA-256 lives there.
What IS committed is the `expected` block below: the digests this seed and
size must reproduce. It exists so a checker can compare a hash instead of
trusting a rebuild, and so an accidental change to the corpus, the plan or
the writer fails loudly instead of quietly producing a different fixture.
`make fixtures` compares against it and EXITS 4 on a mismatch, printing both
hash pairs on stderr; the comparison runs in --quiet as well.
asserts the same comparison inside the suite.
If the fixture changed ON PURPOSE: rebuild with --no-check-expected, then
update this block in the SAME commit.
